title: A/R Aging shows the receivable under the payer
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, the customer the work is for.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer B, the payer.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, invoiced for $210.00, billed to customer B, unpaid.
  • Make sure customer A and customer B owe nothing else.
custom_steps:
1. Open the A/R Aging report for today.
  2. Find customer B's row.
  3. Find customer A's row.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The report opens.

Step 2:

  • Customer B's row shows $210.00 owed (work order 1's invoice), in the bucket for today's invoice.

Step 3:

  • Customer A has no row, or a row with $0.00 owed: the receivable is customer B's.
